items.description:
Selected projects from argoproj (other than the four projects mentioned above) and argoproj-labs:
Other open source projects that use Argo:

items.title: Argo Helm
items.description: is a collection of community-maintained Helm charts for Argo projects.

repo_info.description: ArgoProj Helm Charts

items.title: Argo CD Image Updater
items.description: is a tool to automatically update the container images of Kubernetes workloads which are managed by Argo CD.

repo_info.description: Automatic container image update for Argo CD

items.title: Argo CD Autopilot
items.description: offers an opinionated way of installing Argo CD and managing GitOps repositories.

repo_info.description: Argo-CD Autopilot

items.title: Argo CD Vault Plugin
items.description: is an Argo CD plugin to retrieve secrets from Secret Management tools and inject them into Kubernetes resources.

repo_info.description: An Argo CD plugin to retrieve secrets from Secret Management tools and inject them into Kubernetes secrets

items.title: Hera
items.description: is an Argo Python SDK. Hera aims to make construction and submission of various Argo Project resources easy and accessible to everyone.

repo_info.description: Hera makes Python code easy to orchestrate on Argo Workflows through native Python integrations. It lets you construct and submit your Workflows entirely in Python. ⭐️ Remember to star!

items.title: Argo CD Operator
items.description: is a Kubernetes operator for managing Argo CD clusters.

repo_info.description: A Kubernetes operator for managing Argo CD clusters.

items.title: Argo CD Agent
items.description: aims to improve scalability and security of Argo CD's multi-cluster capabilities

repo_info.description: Redefining the multi cluster story of Argo CD

items.title: Notifications Engine
items.description: is a configuration-driven Golang library that provides notifications for cloud-native applications.

repo_info.description: Affordable notifications for Kubernetes

items.title: Argo Rollout Extension
items.description: contains the Argo Rollout dashboard that can be added into the Argo CD Web UI.

repo_info.description: Argo Rollout visualization in Argo CD Web UI

items.title: Argo Rollouts Manager
items.description: is a Kubernetes operator that provides an easy way to install, upgrade and manage the lifecycle of Argo Rollouts.

repo_info.description: Kubernetes Operator for Argo Rollouts controller.

items.title: Argo CD Extensions
items.description: enables extensions for Argo CD.

repo_info.description: Support for extending Argo CD

items.title: Argo CD RBAC Operator
items.description: is a Kubernetes operator for managing Argo CD's RBAC. It supports both global scoped RBAC () and project scoped RBAC (AppProjects).

repo_info.description: Kubernetes Operator for Argo CD RBAC Management.

items.title: Argo Workflows Catalog
items.description: contains free reusable templates for Argo Workflows.

repo_info.description: Argo Workflows Catalog

items.title: Argo CD Interlace
items.description: is a Kubernetes controller to enable software supply chain security capabilities in Argo CD.

repo_info.description: Enabling Software Supply Chain Security Capabilities in ArgoCD

items.title: Meshery
items.description: is the open source, cloud native manager that enables the design and management of all Kubernetes-based infrastructure and applications (multi-cloud).

repo_info.description: Meshery, the cloud native manager

items.title: Kedro
items.description: is an open-source Python framework for creating reproducible, maintainable and modular data science code.

repo_info.description: Kedro is a toolbox for production-ready data science. It uses software engineering best practices to help you create data engineering and data science pipelines that are reproducible, maintainable, and modular.

items.title: Reloader
items.description: is a Kubernetes controller to watch changes in ConfigMap and Secrets and do rolling upgrades on associated Deployments/StatefulSets/Daemonsets and Argo Rollouts.

repo_info.description: A Kubernetes controller to watch changes in ConfigMap and Secrets and do rolling upgrades on Pods with their associated Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet and DeploymentConfig – [✩Star] if you're using it!

items.title: Metaflow
items.description: is a Python library for building and managing real-life data science projects.

repo_info.description: Build, Manage and Deploy AI/ML Systems

items.title: Devtron
items.description: is a Web-Based CI/CD Platform for Kubernetes, powered by Argo.

repo_info.description: The only Kubernetes dashboard you need

items.title: SQLFlow
items.description: extends SQL to support AI and compiles the SQL program to a workflow that runs on Kubernetes.

repo_info.description: Brings SQL and AI together.

items.title: Seldon
items.description: is an MLOps framework to package, deploy, monitor and manage thousands of production machine learning models.

repo_info.description: An MLOps framework to package, deploy, monitor and manage thousands of production machine learning models

items.title: Kubeflow Pipelines
items.description: is dedicated to making deployments of machine learning workflows on Kubernetes simple, portable, and scalable with Kubeflow.

repo_info.description: Machine Learning Pipelines for Kubeflow

items.title: Orchest
items.description: is a tool for building data pipelines/workflows. It supports Jupyter notebooks and scripts in multiple languages and provides a user friendly UI/browser based editor.

repo_info.description: Build data pipelines, the easy way 🛠️

items.title: Kargo
items.description: helps GitOps practitioners streamline continuous delivery for Kubernetes by automating the progression of changes from one environment to the next.

repo_info.description: Application lifecycle orchestration

items.title: Ploomber
items.description: helps overcome the challenges of working with Jupyter notebooks and allows teams to develop collaborative, production-ready pipelines using JupyterLab or any text editor.

repo_info.description: The fastest ⚡️ way to build data pipelines. Develop iteratively, deploy anywhere. ☁️

items.title: kubefirst
items.description: provides fully automated open source application delivery and infrastructure management GitOps platforms for Kubernetes.

repo_info.description: The Kubefirst Open Source Platform

items.title: Kubeflow Katib
items.description: is a Kubernetes-native project for automated machine learning (AutoML).

repo_info.description: Automated Machine Learning on Kubernetes

items.title: Couler
items.description: provides a unified interface for constructing and managing workflows on different workflow engines.

repo_info.description: Unified Interface for Constructing and Managing Workflows on different workflow engines, such as Argo Workflows, Tekton Pipelines, and Apache Airflow.

items.title: Onepanel
items.description: is the open source, end-to-end computer vision platform.

repo_info.description: The open source, end-to-end computer vision platform. Label, build, train, tune, deploy and automate in a unified platform that runs on any cloud and on-premises.

items.title: kubechecks
items.description: is a tool to check what changes a pull-request will make to your ArgoCD applications, with reporting directly in the PR.

repo_info.description: Check your Kubernetes changes before they hit the cluster

items.title: terraform-provider-argocd
items.description: is the Terraform provider for Argo CD.

repo_info.description: Terraform provider for Argo CD

items.title: argocd-lovely-plugin
items.description: is a plugin that allows you to composite multiple things together into a single argocd application or applicationSet. Includes allowing Helm+Kustomize, addition other manifests trivially and running additional plugins in a pipe.

repo_info.description: A plugin to make Argo CD behave like we'd like.

items.title: deployKF
items.description: effortlessly integrates Kubeflow, and leading MLOps tools on Kubernetes into open ML platforms (uses Argo CD and Argo Workflows).

repo_info.description: deployKF builds machine learning platforms on Kubernetes. We combine the best of Kubeflow, Airflow†, and MLflow† into a complete platform.

items.title: argonaut
items.description: is a TUI application for managing apps in Argo CD with real-time monitoring, diff viewing, and sync/rollback operations.

repo_info.description: Keyboard-first terminal UI for Argo CD. Browse apps, scope by clusters/namespaces/projects, stream live resource status, trigger syncs, inspect diffs, and roll back safely — all without leaving your terminal.

items.title: Nixidy
items.description: is a tool to apply the rendered manifest pattern using NixOS-like modules to define Argo CD applications.

repo_info.description: Kubernetes GitOps with nix and Argo CD.

items.title: Cello
items.description: is a service for running infrastructure as code software tools including CDK, Terraform and Cloud Formation via GitOps.

repo_info.description: Run infrastructure as code (IaC) software tools including CDK, Terraform and Cloud Formation via GitOps.

items.title: k8s-bootstrapper
items.description: is a framework to set up production ready Kubernetes clusters using Terraform and Argo CD.

repo_info.description: Bootstrapping a Production-Ready DigitalOcean Kubernetes Cluster Using Terraform and Argo CD

items.title: active-monitor
items.description: is a Kubernetes controller which enables deep cluster monitoring and self-healing using Argo Workflows.

repo_info.description: Provides deep monitoring and self-healing of Kubernetes clusters

items.title: argocd-commenter
items.description: is a Kubernetes controller to notify a change of Argo CD Application status via comments on GitHub pull requests and GitHub Deployments.

repo_info.description: Notify ArgoCD Application status via Pull Request comment or GitHub Deployment API

items.title: applicationset-progressive-sync
items.description: is a controller to allow a progressive sync of ArgoCD Applications generated by an ApplicationSet.

repo_info.description: Progressive sync controller for Argo ApplicationSet

items.title: KubeStellar Console
items.description: is an AI-powered multi-cluster Kubernetes management dashboard (CNCF Sandbox) that integrates with Argo CD for GitOps-driven workload placement and monitoring across edge and cloud clusters.

repo_info.description: World's first fully integrated and fully Automated Kubernetes management and orchestration solution

items.title: Orkestra
items.description: is a cloud-native release orchestration and lifecycle management (LCM) platform for the fine-grained orchestration of inter-dependent Helm charts and their dependencies.

repo_info.description: Orkestra is a cloud-native release orchestration and lifecycle management (LCM) platform for the fine-grained orchestration of inter-dependent helm charts and their dependencies

items.title: argocd-trivy-extension
items.description: is Argo CD extension to enable visualization of Trivy generated vulnerability reports in Argo CD UI.

repo_info.description: An Argo CD extension to enable visualization of Trivy generated vulnerability reports in Argo CD UI.

items.title: argo-cd-mixin
items.description: is a monitoring mixin for ArgoCD. A set of Grafana dashboards and Prometheus rules for ArgoCD.

repo_info.description: Monitoring mixin for ArgoCD. A set of Grafana dashboards and Prometheus rules for ArgoCD.

items.title: argo-watcher
items.description: is a small service that improves the visibility of deployments that are using Argo CD Image Updater.

repo_info.description: A service that bridges traditional pipelines and GitOps, improving deployment visibility. Includes a built-in GitOps repo updater.

items.title: argo-cd-action
items.description: is a GitHub Action for executing Argo CD.

repo_info.description: GitHub action for executing Argo CD 🦑

items.title: provider-argocd
items.description: is the Crossplane infrastructure provider for Argo CD.

repo_info.description: Crossplane provider to provision and manage Argo CD objects

items.title: ci-github-notifiter
items.description: is a lightweight container to post Argo Workflow statuses back to GitHub as Status Checks.

repo_info.description: Posts the state of a CI workflow task to GitHub

items.title: argo-compare
items.description: is a small CLI tool showing the difference in the resulting helm manifests rendered from Applications in different git branches.

repo_info.description: A comparison tool for displaying the differences between ArgoCD Applications in different Git branches

items.title: Piper
items.description: is a Kubernetes controller which enables managing multi-branch pipelines for Argo Workflows to shift left pipeline configuraiton.

repo_info.description: MultiBranch Pipeline For Argo Workflows

items.title: argocd-nutshell
items.description: is a set of scripts to set up repeatable, zero-conf demo and test environments for Argo CD using Vagrant, Ansible and VirtualBox

repo_info.description: Argo CD in a nutshell. Reproducible, clean Argo CD setups for demoing, development or troubleshooting as a ready-to-use Vagrantfile.

items.title: argopm
items.description: is a package manager for Argo Workflows. It enables developers to distribute and consume argo workflow templates as reusable modules.

repo_info.description: Ship argo workflows in packages

items.title: argo-trivy-insights
items.description: is a Argo CD extension to view and analyze Trivy vulnerability findings for individual Argo CD applications or across your entire GitOps fleet.

repo_info.description: Argo CD UI extension showing Trivy insights natively in the ArgoCD UI.

items.title: Juno
items.description: is an Argo Workflows Generator written in Typescript. Juno helps take the pain out of writing workflows in YAML

repo_info.description: Juno makes it easy to define Argo Workflows with Typescript.

items.title: argocd-gitops-updater-action
items.description: is a GitHub Action that bumps Helm chart and container image versions in GitOps repos, with Argo CD and Kustomize auto-discovery, semver bumps and Slack/Teams/Discord/Telegram notifications.

repo_info.description: GitHub Action that automates Helm chart and Docker image version updates in GitOps repos. ArgoCD and Kustomize aware, with auto-discovery, semver bumps and Slack/Teams/Discord/Telegram notifications.
